title: Methane pyrolysis for hydrogen production: navigating the path to a net zero future
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,2747-2790
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06191H, Review Article

Alireza Lotfollahzade Moghaddam, Sohrab Hejazi, Moslem Fattahi, Md Golam Kibria, Murray J. Thomson, Rashed AlEisa, M. A. Khan
Hydrogen is a versatile energy vector, pivotal to a NetZero future, but will require the development of technologies for low-carbon hydrogen production like methane pyrolysis and new value chains that connect supply to demand.
